title: Household Survey on the Gendered Access to Electricity and Uses of Appliances in Selected Contexts in Rural Nepal, Kenya and India (EFEWEE Project)
descriptions: “The report derives from the independent research project “Exploring factors that Enhance and restrict Women’s Empowerment through Electrification” (EFEWEE). The project constitutes Research Area 1, ‘Electrification through grid and decentralised systems’, under the Gender and Energy Research Programme funded by the UK Department for International Development (DFID), coordinated by ENERGIA, the International Network on Gender and Sustainable Energy”
